title: Home · projects and recent chats
notes: Unassigned chats come first without a section title. Active rows carry their role color. Archived projects follow the active projects.

title: Bot chat · active
notes: The main chat is b2. Every sidebar entry for b2 is selected; input is purple. Internal messages start collapsed.

title: Input · grows naturally
notes: The composer grows to fit visual lines; the two bars and target row remain outside editable text.

title: Home · empty workspace
notes: A first run shows an empty workspace. Configuration is managed through the assistant, not through forms.

title: Home · ten chats per project
notes: Each group is independently capped at ten recent chats, even when another group has hundreds. Scroll the main panel without moving the sidebar.

title: Home · archived projects
notes: Archived projects appear below active sections, one muted line each, ordered by archive time.

title: Help · full-mode bindings
notes: Bindings are aligned in cell columns. M-0 starts a new manager; M-1 selects the first recent bot, aligned with cb0 for the first manager.

title: Help · cowork bindings
notes: Help itself remains an ordinary main buffer in cowork mode; reading help must not rebuild full mode.

title: Locations · named directories
notes: Locations are read-only and organized by name and working directory. Ask the assistant to make changes; navigating here preserves the input draft.

title: Chat · moved during work
notes: The bot shows its interrupted status and the new location. Resuming must actually use the new cwd; merely changing the badge is insufficient.

title: Projects · descriptions and README
notes: Projects are read-only. Descriptions and README paths expose context; the assistant makes changes through the API and project instructions.

title: Chat · project context
notes: The manager checks the project description and reads its README before delegating. The bot inherits the intended project and location.

title: Manager chat · orange
notes: m0 is orange, b# is purple, and user messages remain blue. The manager number is independent of the bot counter.

title: Bot chat · completed
notes: A completed chat has a muted circle in its badge and no circle in its shortcut tab.

title: Bot chat · interrupted
notes: An interrupted chat uses a red status circle and an explicit interruption notification.

title: Bot chat · cancelled
notes: Cancellation is distinct from successful completion. The conversation remains readable and resumable.

title: Bot chat · error
notes: An error is visible in the badge, tab, and notification. Existing messages and the draft remain intact.

title: Bot chat · blocked
notes: A concise blocked notification describes the missing prerequisite rather than saying the bot is done.

title: Chat · no messages yet
notes: Opening a newly created chat keeps the layout and gives the input the correct target.

title: Streaming · following the bottom
notes: Output follows the bottom only if the reader was already there. Input focus and any partial draft remain untouched.

title: Streaming · reading earlier messages
notes: New output must not scroll a reader back to the bottom. This fixture is deliberately scrolled into earlier messages.

title: Markdown · headings, lists, code, links
notes: Markup is rendered for reading; decorative borders are display-only. Copying returns literal selected message content.

title: Internal messages · collapsed
notes: A consecutive run of internal events becomes one gray group. The visible user and assistant sequence is preserved.

title: Internal messages · expanded
notes: RET expands the group underneath its summary. The expansion survives new events and can be collapsed again.

title: Selection · borders excluded
notes: The blue selection contains message text only. Expected copied text: "Keep the sidebar reachable."

title: Text link · main editor buffer
notes: RET on a text link opens that file in the existing main window, resolved against the chat location.

title: Media link · external open
notes: Images, videos, HTML, and binary files open externally. The terminal remains on the chat and keeps its draft.

title: Delegation · literal user request and context
notes: The two required sections remain visible as the bot’s initial user message. Manager context adds only information absent from the user’s wording.

title: New manager · empty one-line input
notes: M-0 prepares a new manager conversation. Creating and numbering the chat must not lose the draft.

title: Input · one purple line
notes: Only the editable line contains the cursor. The bars and target row never become editable.

title: Input · one orange line
notes: The same input becomes orange when addressed to m0. Main content remains b2.

title: Input · soft wrapping
notes: Growth uses displayed lines, including soft wraps. Wrapping never inserts spaces or newlines into the submitted text.

title: Input · ten-line limit
notes: At ten visual lines, the composer stops growing and preserves useful main content.

title: Input · scroll within the draft
notes: When the draft exceeds ten visual lines, its viewport follows the cursor while all three control rows remain pinned.

title: Input · edit the middle
notes: A refresh must preserve the editing position inside the draft, not move it to the end. Undo applies only to text edits.

title: Input · C-g clears
notes: Clearing removes text and attachments and shrinks back to one line. Full mode keeps its composer open.

title: Attachments · images and sizes
notes: Attachments are listed before editable text. RET or click on [del] removes only that item; the name opens the image.

title: Attachment · removed without losing draft
notes: Removing an attachment preserves the draft, cursor, and text undo history.

title: Attachment · no text
notes: An image-only draft is sendable. Empty text alone must not prevent submission when an attachment exists.

title: Clipboard · no image
notes: A missing image produces a concise message and leaves the draft untouched.

title: Send · in flight
notes: A second M-RET cannot duplicate the request. Text remains visible until acknowledgement.

title: Send · failure preserves draft
notes: The error is actionable and the complete draft and attachments remain available for retry.

title: Send · late reply cannot erase new text
notes: The earlier submission succeeded after the user typed a new draft. The new text and recipient must remain untouched.

title: Send · success
notes: Acknowledged text appears once in the chat. Only the submitted draft is cleared; input returns to one line.

title: Sidebar · all matching rows selected
notes: Every active/unread/read entry belonging to the selected chat shares the orange left rule and dark highlight.

title: Sidebar · scroll survives refresh
notes: The sidebar is scrolled independently. An arriving event does not return it to row zero or move the text cursor.

title: Sidebar · beyond 36 shortcuts
notes: The shortcut alphabet ends at z, but notifications do not disappear. Later entries remain clickable and reachable by scrolling.

title: Sidebar · recent five read
notes: The read section shows only the five newest entries; active and unread sections are not capped at five.

title: Sidebar · relative timestamps
notes: Recent updates use minutes or hours. Older entries use month and day, with muted right-aligned timestamps.

title: Bars · overflow without wrapping
notes: Each tab is at most 20 cells and the bot row lists up to nine chats and the manager row up to ten chats, plus the M-0 new action. Overflow stays on one line and exposes a scroll affordance.

title: Bars · reveal later entries
notes: Scrolling a bar changes what is visible, never the shortcut index. M-4 still selects its original slot.

title: Titles · truncation and identity
notes: Long titles truncate with an ellipsis rather than wrapping controls. The UUID, not the visible title or label, remains identity.

title: Labels · wrap and historical duplicates
notes: Historical b0 and m0 labels can repeat. Search distinguishes conversations by title/time; API operations always use UUIDs.

title: Cowork · ordinary chat buffer
notes: C-x 1 leaves full mode and keeps only the main buffer. The sidebar and composer are absent until explicitly requested.

title: Cowork · split right
notes: C-x 3 first leaves full mode, then splits the main chat like an ordinary Emacs buffer. Repeating the command follows normal Emacs behavior.

title: Cowork · split below
notes: C-x 2 creates an ordinary vertical stack after removing the full-mode panels.

title: Cowork · chat beside code
notes: A chat and a normal file can coexist. Opening links must not create an accumulating series of extra windows.

title: Cowork · summon the input
notes: M-/ opens a full-width temporary composer targeting the visible chat from which it was invoked.

title: Cowork · cycle visible targets
notes: Repeated M-/ follows visible-buffer order, then the manager fallback. The focused input retains its draft.

title: Cowork · C-g closes input
notes: C-g clears the composer and closes its window in cowork mode, returning focus to the source buffer.

title: Cowork · return to home
notes: C-M-h is the explicit return to full mode. The three-panel arrangement is restored once, with no leftover cowork splits.

title: Search · fuzzy label and title
notes: The query "1 scroll" can match b21 and title words in order. Searching goes beyond the cached 20 chats; results load 50 at a time, with RET on [Show 50 more] to continue.

title: Search · no matches
notes: An empty result set preserves the query and gives a useful recovery hint.

title: Search · loading older results
notes: A remote search shows its in-flight state. A late response from an older query must not replace newer results.

title: Workspace · initial loading
notes: Loading keeps a recognizable stable shell and lets the user retain a draft while the workspace connects.

title: Workspace · load failed
notes: A page-level failure has a retry action. The draft remains editable and is never erased by failure.

title: Connection · reconnecting
notes: During server restart or blue/green handoff, existing content and drafts remain visible. Reconnect reconciles missed state without changing focus.

title: Connection · recovered
notes: After reconnect, completed messages and notifications are reconciled once. The reader remains at the same place.

title: Shadow chat · never visible
notes: The fixture deliberately includes an active shadow chat. It is absent from every badge, bar, homepage, and notification entry.

title: Completion · concise outcome
notes: The notification describes the useful result, omits the invisible shadow identity, and does not merely announce completion.

title: Text · wide characters and literal paths
notes: Cell widths account for wide characters and combining marks. Paths and selected text retain their literal contents.

title: Frame · narrow but usable
notes: The 96×32 fixture keeps the 30-column sidebar and a usable content/input area. The 400×80 version checks that extra width does not add panels.

title: Notification · multiline body
notes: Notification summaries wrap inside the sidebar instead of being flattened into one truncated line.

title: Locations · no configured entries
notes: Reference content only. Changes are made through the assistant using the project README and API.

title: Projects · no configured entries
notes: Reference content only. Changes are made through the assistant using the project README and API.

title: Project · README context
notes: Reference content only. Changes are made through the assistant using the project README and API.

title: Search · first 50 results
notes: The gray query line is editable. Arrow keys select results below it; RET opens a chat or loads the next 50. Cursor movement stays within the query and options.

title: Search · Show 50 more selected
notes: The gray query line is editable. Arrow keys select results below it; RET opens a chat or loads the next 50. Cursor movement stays within the query and options.

title: Search · next 50 results
notes: The gray query line is editable. Arrow keys select results below it; RET opens a chat or loads the next 50. Cursor movement stays within the query and options.

title: Search · final batch
notes: The gray query line is editable. Arrow keys select results below it; RET opens a chat or loads the next 50. Cursor movement stays within the query and options.
